title: relay_queue.py and relay_setup.py hold many subjects
what: Each is split by subject (queue: records and schema, add, take/done, views; setup: naming, settings merge, migrate, doctor) with no behaviour change, done at a wave boundary when no open branch changes either file (the collision command says free).
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "агенты позволяют нам делать множество изменений одновременно, большие файлы - наши враги, концентрируя большой объем кода (смысла) они являются поводом для конфликтов", then "a" (principle 10 "one subject per file, no hub files, no copies" plus four items). Measured over 5 days: bin/relay (887 lines) in 44 commits, lib/relay_queue.py (1189 lines) in 25 commits kept in 3 copies, lib/relay_setup.py (1134 lines) changed by 3 open branches at once (license, setup-wt, the portable-tool design). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: lib/relay_setup.py is changed by wt/license, wt/setup-wt and the coming portable-tool build at once.
pass_cases: The full test suite passes unchanged; no module over about 500 lines keeps two of the listed subjects.
